notes: Three ruined courts linked by two stone and two timber crossings, with six primary architectural groups.
All water, walls, architecture, vegetation and unsafe cliff margins block every element.
Collision rows were refined against the final painted top surfaces and continuous cardinal foot sweeps.
Ruin silhouettes and low walls were fitted to clear the walking lanes; the central eastern bank was widened.
Remaining coastal rock faces and narrow lips were conservatively retired from the final movement mask.
All four bridge components have at least two-cell-wide opposing bank contacts and alternate paths.
Guide images record design provenance; the final movement mask is SeaRuinsMapLayout.h and these rows.
Hash and geometry checks detect stale pairing, not semantic image recognition or native gameplay execution.
